summary: Iteration 222 - Batch 9 P1 Keyless Features (11-16 of 20) tested. All 6 features working: (1) Multi-language Message Templates with language fallback, (2) Birthday Auto-Discount, (3) Low-Stock Alerts, (4) Quick Re-booking CTA, (5) Stay Extension Wizard, (6) Long-Stay Discount Auto-Apply. critical_code_review_comments: All 6 Batch 9 P1 features implemented correctly with proper validation and error handling
Msg Templates: 12 known keys, upsert by (property_id+key+language), render with fallback (requested lang → en → any active), merge tags {first_name} {hotel_name} etc working
Birthday: Config saves lookahead_days/discount_pct/voucher_validity_days, sweep finds guests with date_of_birth in window, idempotent (skipped_duplicates), voucher source='birthday'
Low-Stock: Reads from stock_items/inventory_items/pos_inventory/menu_items (first non-empty), computes status (ok|low|out), scan creates alerts idempotently, dismiss flips status
Rebook: Sweep finds bookings with check_out exactly N days ago + status=checked_out, queues with token, idempotent, click tracking working
Stay-Ext: Quote returns rate_per_night × extra_nights × (1-disc%/100) + room_available check, apply writes new check_out + folio_charges + stay_extensions_log
Long-Stay: Ladder validates min_nights ≥ 2 and discount_pct > 0, sweep applies max threshold met, creates negative folio_charges (category=discount), idempotent via long_stay_discount_applied flag
seed_data_creation: None - used existing default property with seeded bookings
